mechanism_claims.claim_text: Octominin treatment causes visible cell wall and surface morphology damage in C. albicans at MIC and MFC concentrations.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=5:2.3. Effects of Octominin on Morphological Changes of C. albicans
xml:sec=12:4.5. Analysis of Morphological Changes of C. albicans upon Octominin Treatment

mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct microscopy supports structural damage, but not a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Propidium iodide uptake shows Octominin increases C. albicans membrane permeability at MIC and MFC concentrations.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=7:2.5. Effect of Octominin on the Membrane Permeability of C. albicans
xml:sec=12:4.6. Determination of the Effect of Octominin on the Membrane Permeability of C. albicans

mechanism_claims.limitations: PI uptake supports membrane-permeability disruption; the paper frames exact pore/channel formation as proposed, not directly proven.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Octominin increases ROS-associated fluorescence in C. albicans at MIC and MFC concentrations, supporting oxidative-stress involvement.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=8:2.6. Effects of Octominin on ROS Production in C. albicans
xml:sec=12:4.7. Effect of Octominin on ROS Production in C. albicans

mechanism_claims.limitations: ROS accumulation is direct assay evidence for oxidative stress, but the paper does not prove whether ROS is upstream, downstream, or required for killing.

limitations: The primary paper proposes possible pore/channel, nucleus/DNA, and apoptosis extensions; these are not promoted to direct mechanisms without direct assay evidence.
